newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to sell stake in CEB power firm Wed.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to sell stake in CEB power firm Wed.

text.p: Brazil's Federal District said it will sell Wednesday an 18.37 percent stake in power distributor Companhia Energetica de Brasilia (CEB) at a minimum price of 135.03 reais per 1,000 shares.

The district government said in tender documents published Monday that a total of 540.9 million preferred shares will go on the auction block at 1315 local time/1615 GMT on the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange.
The district said Brazilian banks Bradesco, Garantia, Itau Bankers Trust and Pactual will broker the sale.

The federal district owns a 79.48 percent controlling stake in CEB, while district-owned companies hold 12.15 percent of the firm, and federal power holding Eletrobras , pension funds and private investors own the rest.
CEB's net profit jumped 112.7 percent to 25.1 million reais last year compared with 1995, the documents said.
